name: gauge-chart
title: Gauge chart
description: One value against its range and an optional target, as a half ring.

when: One figure against a goal: utilization, a quota.

instead.when: A compact bar with warning and danger thresholds fits better in a row or card.
The value is how far a task has got.
The figure and its change matter more than its range.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.

genui.description: One value against a range and an optional target.
